The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Program Highlights Top-Notch Faculty Trainers at ExcelR are passionate about training, and carry vast industry experience. Industry Aligned Curriculum Our industry-relevant course curriculum is tailored to provide practical exposure with the theory. 20+ Capstone Projects Learners will work on real-life data analytics scenarios from various domains to get application knowledge. Job Readiness Intensive interview preparation from Day 1 to prepare candidates for interviews with our network of 5000+ hiring partners. Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... What is the difference between Data Scientist & Data Analyst? Data Analysts assist Data Scientists by extracting and cleaning data using various tools before it is used for building models. Data Scientists then build machine learning algorithms using Python. Data Analysts and Data Scientists work in the same stream but differ in skill levels and focus areas. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More... Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More...
